'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet uses joke titles ('''Communism''' for [[Communing]], Premiere C-3PO note, etc.); dest [[Kevin Shannon]]. Line 22 sheet nickname normalized to [[Orrimaarko]] pending QA if misread.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing]]
* '''Username:''' Aglets
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
